project_type: Vanilla JavaScript e-commerce application with HTML/CSS frontend and localStorage persistence
build_system: None - static HTML/CSS/JS files served directly from browser
test_command: Open index.html in browser, test user flows and admin flows manually
verification_instructions: 1. Open index.html in browser (or use Live Server). 2. Test user registration/login. 3. Add products to cart and checkout. 4. Login as admin (admin@anihan.ph / anihan2024admin). 5. Verify admin dashboard shows correct data. 6. Test all new features (order history, stock management, product CRUD, profile). 7. Check browser console for errors. 8. Test on mobile viewport (responsive design).
environment_constraints: Uses localStorage for all persistence - data is browser-specific and not shared across browsers/devices. No backend or build tools. All code runs client-side.
contribution_requirements: Maintain existing code style: ES6 modules, JSDoc comments, responsive design for mobile and desktop, green color scheme (#174b35), ARIA labels for accessibility, follow existing patterns in database.js/auth.js/app.js
key_patterns: database.js provides CRUD operations (getProducts, addOrder, updateOrderStatus). auth.js handles authentication (loginUser, registerUser, getCurrentUser, isAdmin). app.js uses notify() for toast messages, renderProducts() to update product grid, updateAuthUI() to show/hide login buttons. Modals use <dialog> element with .showModal() and data-close attributes. All database functions return objects with .success and .error fields. Session stored in localStorage as 'anihan_session'. Product cards use grid layout. Admin panel uses tabs with data-panel attributes.
directory_structure: Root contains 5 main files: index.html (all UI including modals), app.js (application logic), database.js (localStorage CRUD), auth.js (authentication), style.css (all styling). No subdirectories for source code. .agents/tasks/ contains planning artifacts.
